title: Outcomes of Descemet Membrane Endothelial Keratoplasty in Bangkok, Thailand

license.statement: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating CC BY-NC 3.0 unported (article <license>); not CC BY, record kept private

indication: Corneal endothelial failure: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy 33/62, pseudophakic bullous keratopathy 11/62, decompensation after viral endotheliitis 6/62, failed DSAEK/DMEK 4/62, bullous keratopathy after laser iridotomy 3/62, other 5/62; DMEK alone in 33 pseudophakic eyes, triple-DMEK in 29 phakic eyes

groups.description: Consecutive DMEK and triple-DMEK (standard technique, SF6 20% tamponade, standard steroid regimen); ECD reported for the 51 eyes with a clear graft

series.baseline_label: Preoperative = donor post-harvesting ECD reported by the provider eye banks (Methods; Table 2 row 'Mean post-harvesting ECD')
series.notes: row label 'ECD, mean ± SD (cell/mm2) (51 eyes)'; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.reason: blank cell: ECD was not measured at 1 month (Methods: 3, 6, 12 and 24 months)
percent loss derived from the same series; the absolute ECD series is used

notes: Retrospective single-centre cohort of 62 eyes of 62 patients with at least 24 months of follow-up; three surgeons, same technique.

The ECD row covers the 51 eyes with a clear graft: the authors excluded the 11 eyes with primary (10) or secondary (1) graft failure from further analysis, so follow-up values are conditional on graft survival.

The reference cell repeats the mean and SD of all 62 donor tissues in Table 2 (t0003!R18C2 matches t0002!R6C2), so the reference may include the donors of the 11 failed grafts; the tabulated ECL is computed against this reference.
Donor tissue from the Thai Red Cross Eye Bank (19) or EBAA-accredited US eye banks (43); postoperative ECD by non-contact specular microscopy (EM-3000) in the clinic.
Pooled DMEK and triple-DMEK; the table does not separate them.
